# Game Idea: Neon Runner

A minimalist endless runner for HTML canvas. The player controls a neon square that automatically moves forward through a scrolling corridor. Tap or click to jump over gaps and slide under barriers. Randomly generated obstacles increase difficulty. **Lose condition:** collision with an obstacle or falling into a gap ends the game.

1: // Minimal endless runner for canvas#game
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   // Audio setup
5:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
6:   // Ensure audio context is resumed on first user interaction
7:   function resumeAudio(){
8:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
9:   }
10:   canvas.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio, {once:true});
11:   canvas.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio, {once:true});
12:   function playTone(freq, duration){
13:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
16:     osc.type = 'square';
17:     osc.connect(gain);
18:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
19:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
20:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
21:     osc.start();
22:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
23:   }
24:   function playJump(){ playTone(400, 0.08); }
25:   function playGameOver(){ playTone(150, 0.5); }
26:   if (!canvas) return;
27:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
28:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
29:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
30: 
31: // Game constants
32:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
33:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
34:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 30;
35:   const PLAYER_X = width * 0.2;
36:   const OBSTACLE_SPEED = 4;
37:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
38:   // Starfield constants
39:   const STAR_COUNT = Math.floor((width * height) / 5000);
40:   const STAR_SPEED_MIN = 0.5;
41:   const STAR_SPEED_MAX = 2.0;
42:   let stars = [];
43:   function initStars(){
44:     stars = [];
45:     for(let i=0;i<STAR_COUNT;i++){
46:       stars.push({
47:         x: Math.random()*width,
48:         y: Math.random()*height,
49:         size: Math.random()*2+1,
50:         speed: STAR_SPEED_MIN + Math.random()*(STAR_SPEED_MAX-STAR_SPEED_MIN)
51:       });
52:     }
53:   }
54: 
55:   let playerY = height - PLAYER_SIZE;
56:   let velocityY = 0;
57:   let isJumping = false;
58:   let obstacles = [];
59:   let lastSpawn = 0;
60:   let gameOver = false;
61: 
62:   function reset() {
63:     initStars();
64:     playerY = height - PLAYER_SIZE;
65:     velocityY = 0;
66:     obstacles = [];
67:     lastSpawn = performance.now();
68:     gameOver = false;
69:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
70:   }
71: 
72:   function spawnObstacle() {
73:     const gapHeight = Math.random() * 80 + 40; // height of gap from bottom
74:     const size = Math.random() * 40 + 20; // obstacle thickness
75:     obstacles.push({x: width, w: size, gapY: gapHeight});
76:   }
77: 
78:   function update(dt) {
79:     // player physics
80:     // (existing code unchanged)
81:     // player physics
82:     if (isJumping) {
83:       velocityY = JUMP_VELOCITY;
84:       isJumping = false;
85:     }
86:     velocityY += GRAVITY;
87:     playerY += velocityY;
88:     if (playerY > height - PLAYER_SIZE) {
89:       playerY = height - PLAYER_SIZE;
90:       velocityY = 0;
91:     }
92:     // obstacles
93:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= OBSTACLE_SPEED);
94:     // remove offscreen
95:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
96:     // spawn new
97:     const now = performance.now();
98:     if (now - lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
99:       spawnObstacle();
100:       lastSpawn = now;
101:     }
102:     // collision
103:     for (const o of obstacles) {
104:       if (PLAYER_X + PLAYER_SIZE > o.x && PLAYER_X < o.x + o.w) {
105:         // check if player is in the gap
106:         if (playerY + PLAYER_SIZE > height - o.gapY) {
107:           gameOver = true;
108:           break;
109: 
110:       }
111:     }
112:   }
113: 
114:   function draw() {
115:     // clear canvas
116:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
117:     // background gradient
118:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
119:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0d0d1a');
120:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a0d2e');
121:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
122:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
123:     // starfield
124:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
125:     stars.forEach(s => {
126:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
127:     });
128:     // neon glow for player & obstacles
129:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
130:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
131:     // player
132:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
133:     ctx.fillRect(PLAYER_X, playerY, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE);
134:     // obstacles (upper part, leaving gap at bottom)
135:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f';
136:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
137:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, 0, o.w, height - o.gapY);
138:     });
139:     // game over overlay
140:     if (gameOver) {
141:       ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
142:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
143:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
144:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
145:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
146:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
147:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
148:     }
149:   }
150: 
151:   }
152: 
153:   let lastTime = 0;
154:   function loop(timestamp) {
155:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
156:     lastTime = timestamp;
157:     if (!gameOver) {
158:       update(dt);
159:     }
160:     draw();
161:     if (!gameOver) {
162:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
163:     } else {
164:       // restart on click
165:       canvas.addEventListener('click', reset, {once: true});
166:       canvas.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space') reset(); }, {once: true});
167:     }
168:   }
169: 
170:   // input handling
171:   canvas.addEventListener('click', () => { isJumping = true; playJump(); });
172:   canvas.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space') isJumping = true; });
173:   canvas.setAttribute('tabindex', '0'); // make focusable for key events
174: 
175:   reset();
176: })();

</content>
